objective: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

description: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way.
My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
completion: Kaya is alive! <name>, I have you to thank for rescuing her.
